field_decisions.rationale: Research, preservation, public communication and computational inquiry form overlapping practices. The selected plural-root accounts do not justify a single origin date or equivalence to all digital humanities.
Web archives raise specific collection, mediation and source-criticism questions. Histories of the web and histories using the web overlap; neither exhausts digital history.

earlier_roots.note: Milligan 2022 section 1.3, Winters manuscript pp. 4–6 and Gallini/Noiret 2011 pp. 16–18 support plural roots. No direct history of every earlier project, quantitative tradition or computing institution has been completed.

editorial_direction: Represent substantive contributions across digital history. The earlier corrective selection underrepresented male practitioners and project/method traditions. Retain Leon and Gallon while restoring omitted contributions; no numerical gender target or inferred demographic classification.
